facts.fact: Analyst Sekatle Sekatle writes that Lesotho's proposed Artificial Intelligence Bill aims to include mechanisms to detect and mitigate the spread of disinformation and misinformation through responsible AI systems, and urges the government to table it.

LSO.note: Nothing stated on government use of AI.

facts.fact: Analyst Sekatle Sekatle writes that Lesotho has a proposed Artificial Intelligence Bill (cited to Government of Lesotho, 2025) not yet tabled, and urges the government to table it.

LSO.note: Nothing stated on AI in a sector's public system.
Nothing stated on AI built or hosted in the country.

facts.fact: Analyst Sekatle Sekatle writes that Lesotho's proposed Computer and Cyber Security Bill (cited to Government of Lesotho, 2024) is not yet in force and urges the government to table it.

LSO.note: No general data protection law is named; the cyber security bill is the cybersecurity row's.
Only a police social-media error is mentioned; no station record system.
